items.title: Asked David Adelman tonight about Ryan Nembhard joining the Nuggets from the G-League, but sounded like it was more about the opportunity to get Bryce Hopkins reps with the Gold and needing an extra body.
items.author: Ryan Blackburn
items.body_excerpt:
Asked David Adelman tonight about Ryan Nembhard joining the Nuggets from the G-League, but sounded like it was more about the opportunity to get Bryce Hopkins reps with the Gold and needing an extra body.

Adelman said team has a lot of belief in Hopkins. Nembhard likely to be the third PG tonight.
